parse.title: The Cleric
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-Cleric.png}} {{E|The Cleric}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found exclusively in [[Act 1]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}. It can only be encountered if the player has at least 35 [[Gold]]; enough to afford at least one of the options. ==Options== {{Frame|Heal}} {{TS|gold||35 [[Gold]]:}} {{TS|positive||Heal X HP.}} * X is equal to 25% of the player's Max HP, rounded down. {{Frame|Purify}} {{TS|gold||50}} {{Asc|15|(75)}} {{TS|gold||[[Gold]]:}} {{TS|positive||Remove a card from your deck.}} {{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. ==Dialogue==
A strange blue humanoid with a golden helm(?) approaches you with a huge smile. {{TS||shake|"Hello friend!}} I am {{TS|blue||Cleric!}} Are you interested in my services?!" the creature shouts, loudly. {{Frame|Heal}}
A warm golden light envelops your body and dissipates. The creature grins. "Cleric best healer. {{TS||shake|Have a good day!"}}
{{Frame|Purify}}
A cold blue flame envelops your body and dissipates. The creature grins. "Cleric talented. {{TS||shake|Have a good day!"}}
{{Frame|Leave}}
You don't trust this {{TS|blue||"Cleric",}} so you leave.
==Trivia== * Cleric is also encountered in the {{E|Old Beggar}} event. * {{R|Face of Cleric}} from the {{E|Face Trader}} event references Cleric. There is no special dialogue if the player encounters Cleric while owning his face. ==Update History== * '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer''' ** You no longer run into The Cleric or Beggar events if you do not have enough gold. * '''Weekly Patch 50: The Final Act''' ** Fixed softlock caused if you can't remove cards in: Back to Basics, Cleric, and Living Wall events. * '''Weekly Patch 15: Surprise Patch''' ** Cleric now shows and uses correct gold costs on Ascension 15. * '''Weekly Patch 14: Bullet Time''' ** Cleric Event text improvements. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
